en.title: Jesus Dies on the Cross
en.meditation:
Consider how thy Jesus, after three hours’ Agony on the Cross, consumed at length with anguish, abandons Himself to the weight of His body, bows His head, and dies.

O my dying Jesus, I kiss devoutly the Cross on which Thou didst die for love of me. I have merited by my sins to die a miserable death; but Thy death is my hope. Ah, by the merits of Thy death, give me grace to die, embracing Thy feet, and burning with love for Thee. I yield my soul into Thy hands. I love Thee with my whole heart; I repent of ever having offended Thee. Never permit me to offend Thee again. Grant that I may love Thee always; and then do with me what Thou wilt.
en.versicle: We adore Thee, O Christ, and we bless Thee.
en.response: Because by Thy holy Cross, Thou hast redeemed the world.
en.source: eCatholic2000.com, "The Way of the Cross" by St. Alphonsus de Liguori, https://www.ecatholic2000.com/liguori/stations/cross.shtml, retrieved 2026-08-23

fr.title: Jésus meurt sur la croix
fr.meditation:
Considérons comment, après trois heures d’agonie sur la croix, Jésus meurt épuisé enfin par les douleurs, s’affaisse, incline la tête et meurt.

O mon Jésus, j’embrasse avec attendrissement cette croix sur laquelle Vous êtes mort pour moi. Et quand viendra l’heure de ma mort, permettez-moi de Vous donner un dernier baiser sur le Crucifix.
fr.versicle: Nous t’adorons, ô Christ, et nous te bénissons,
fr.response: parce que tu as racheté le monde par ta sainte Croix.
